evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic restatement frames unrehearsed rollback as no rollback at all — urgency-as-worry that what we claim to have, we don't.
Cadence stated as settled fact — low-arousal satisfaction that the rhythm is now fixed.
Self-assignment delivered as a plain label — settled, low-arousal acceptance of responsibility.

mints.name: RehearsalAsPossession
mints.title: a thing we have not rehearsed is a thing we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the speaker converting a capability claim into a rehearsal-or-nothing ultimatum to drive urgency?
